orders.text:
WPMS No. 548 of 2020
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
Issue notice to the respondents 
returnable within four weeks.
List this matter after four weeks.
Till the next date of listing, operation and 
effect of the impugned order dated 18.12.2019 
passed by Uttarakhand Information 
Commission shall remain stayed provided 
petitioner deposits a sum of `12,500/- in the 
Registry of this Court within three weeks, 
which shall be subject to the final decision of 
this writ petition. 
Interim Relief application (CLMA No. 
2140 of 2020) stands disposed of. 
(Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Aswal 02.03.2020

WPMS No. 548 of 2020 
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. 
 
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
None appears for the respondents. 
Time Extension Application (CLMA No. 
4440 of 2020) is allowed. 
One week’s further time is granted to the 
petitioner to deposit the amount of Rs. 12,500/- 
(Rupees Twelve Thousand Five Hundred only) in 
the Registry, as directed by this Court vide order 
dated 02.03.2020. 
List this case on 10.07.2020. 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
 03.07.2020 
Avneet/

WPMS No.548 of 2020
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. 
List revised. Case called out twice. 
None is present for the petitioner. 
In the interest of justice, list this matter after 
three weeks. 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
 10.07.2020 
Nitesh/
